desc: Read input $N$ and $p$, then read the $N \times N$ matrix $A$.
Count the total number of zeros $K$ in matrix $A$.
Calculate the multiplier for non-zero entries: $M = (p-1)^K \pmod p$.
Determine the sum of values $1$ to $p-1$ modulo $p$: if $p=2$ it is $1$, otherwise it is $0$.
Iterate through each cell $(i, j)$ of $A$:
If $A_{i,j} \neq 0$, the result is $(A_{i,j} \times M) \pmod p$.
If $A_{i,j} = 0$, the result is (sum of $1..p-1$) $\times (p-1)^{K-1} \pmod p$.
Print the resulting matrix row by row.
Run the code against Sample 1, Sample 2, and Sample 3 to verify the outputs match the expected results.
